subject: Performance acceptance milestones & load-window schedule (MAP)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@datacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Performance acceptance milestones & load-window schedule (MAP)

Samir —

Following our call this morning, attaching a concise Mutual Action Plan focused on the performance acceptance criteria and the logistics we need to lock to hit the close timeline for DC-1387. High level targets for the benchmark run:

- Acceptance KPIs (target):
  - p95 generation latency <= 220 ms (measured at 512-token context)
  - TTFT (time-to-first-token) median <= 1.2 s, p95 <= 1.8 s
  - Steady-state throughput >= 2,500 tokens/s for a single model instance under planned batching
  - Concurrency target: support 400 concurrent streams with <5% error rate

- Ramp plan (proposal):
  - Pre-checks: Aug 20 (network, auth, small synthetic run)
  - Load windows: Aug 21 08:00–12:00 PDT (ramp to 50%), Aug 22 08:00–14:00 PDT (full ramp + soak)
  - Artifact delivery: benchmark logs & csv by EOD Aug 22; summary walkthrough Aug 23

Logistics requests from DataCo we need:
- A sandbox/test hostname + IP allowlist details (if any)
- Short-lived test API key(s) (scoped to sandbox) we can use for load agents
- Point of contact for on-call infra during the windows

I will attach a compact MAP PDF with milestones and the JMeter script we'll run unless you prefer a different runner. If these windows look doable, we can mark Aug 24 as target for final signature and Aug 25 for provisioning into production (post-acceptance).

Thanks — I know timing is tight, so we want to be explicit about responsibilities and timeline.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.pdf (MAP), load_script_v2.jmx (load script - JMeter), test-keys.txt (placeholder for keys request)

From: Samir Patel <samir@datacorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataCo Performance Team <perf@datacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Performance acceptance milestones & load-window schedule (MAP)

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can accommodate the proposed windows but need to confirm a couple of items:

1) Test credentials: we prefer you use scoped keys that expire after 72 hours. Can you accept short-lived tokens via our portal?
2) Network: there is an internal firewall; please provide the list of Redwood IPs to allow.
3) Ramp timing: prefer start at 09:00 PDT rather than 08:00 on Aug 21 to avoid overlap with a scheduled internal deploy.

We can assign our infra lead (cc'd as perf@datacorp.com) to be on-call during the runs. On the acceptance KPIs: the p95 latency target looks reasonable, but can we include a fallback acceptance for p95 <= 260 ms if the TTFT profile meets expectations? That gives both sides a way to proceed without blocking because of a minor latency tail.

I'll upload our network allowlist and a templated DocuSign for the MAP.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Platform Engineering — DataCo
samir@datacorp.com

Samir —

We can support the short-lived token flow and will prepare scoped keys that expire after 72 hours. Action items (Redwood):

- Deliverables before pre-checks (Aug 20):
  - test-keys.txt (scoped API key + expiry notes) — will be uploaded to the secure portal
  - IP list: 35.201.120.0/24, 34.120.50.0/24 (please confirm these are acceptable for allowlisting)
  - small synthetic sanity run (5k tokens) to validate networking

- Load plan updates: we can shift the Aug 21 start to 09:00 PDT. Ramp schedule below:
  - Aug 21 09:00–11:00 PDT: ramp 0 -> 50% (validate KV cache + batching)
  - Aug 21 11:15–12:30 PDT: run targeted latency profiles (short bursts)
  - Aug 22 09:00–14:00 PDT: full ramp to 100%, soak for 2 hours, then step down

I'll attach a compact guide with how we'll tag runs and where results will land. Please note: the JMeter script is configured to record TTFT and per-request latency, plus token throughput.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Console
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: test-keys.txt, redwood_map_v1.pdf (updated)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@datacorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance acceptance milestones & load-window schedule (MAP)

Samir —

Thanks — received the allowlist and the DocuSign template. We'll use the scoped keys Laura is preparing. Couple quick confirmations before we run:

- Final close timeline: assuming acceptance, propose we move signature target to Aug 24 EOD and provisioning Aug 25 (as in original note). That gives your procurement team two business days after results to sign.
- Ramp detail: we'll execute a 30-minute break-in at 75% on Aug 22 before full soak to catch any cache/eviction behavior.
- Rollback plan: if error rate > 5% or p95 jumps > 40% vs baseline during soak, we will halt and investigate; retry window TBD.

Please confirm approval of the signature/provisioning timeline so I can nudge our finance/provisioning teams.

—Rishi

> On Aug 20, 2026, Laura Bennett wrote:
> > (keys and IPs attached)

From: Samir Patel <samir@datacorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: DataCo Performance Team <perf@datacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Performance acceptance milestones & load-window schedule (MAP)

Rishi/Team —

All set on our side. Keys will be visible in the portal at 08:00 PDT on Aug 21 and expire at 08:00 PDT Aug 24. Firewall rules have been applied to the IP ranges Laura provided. We also uploaded a drive folder with our on-prem telemetry collectors and the DocuSign:

- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-dc-perf
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/preview/DC-1387-MAP

Run summary (post-run notes uploaded to the drive):
- Peak aggregate throughput observed: 3,200 tokens/s (burst)
- Steady-state throughput: 2,600 tokens/s across the reserved instance set
- Latency (generation): p50 68 ms, p95 209 ms
- TTFT median 0.92 s, p95 1.35 s
- Concurrency: sustained 400 concurrent streams during soak; error rate 2.1% (NC = network connection retries)

Verdict: PASS with a transient spike during the second ramp (11:40 PDT) that correlates with a short network hiccup on DataCo's collector vm. We captured packet drops in the collector logs — perf@datacorp.com will share the trace.

We are comfortable moving to signature. Please upload the final acceptance report to the shared drive and add the HubSpot deal note.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Platform Engineering — DataCo
samir@datacorp.com
